$comment: Machine-readable inventory of every third-party component linked into or bundled with a published aria2-webui archive. Consumed by scripts/gen-third-party-notices.mjs, which hard-fails when a vendored license text no longer matches its recorded sha256. Keep `licenseFiles` hashes in sync with the files in this directory.

upstream.name: aria2
upstream.$comment: Every release build is produced from exactly this commit; see ARIA2_TAG / ARIA2_SHA in .github/workflows/release.yml.

correspondingSource: Corresponding source (GPLv3 section 1) for the aria2c binaries in this archive is the aria2 commit recorded in licenses/manifest.json and in this release's notes, with patches/aria2-embed-webui.patch applied, plus the generated src/WebUiBlob.cc, patches/gen_webui_blob.mjs, patches/build-aria2-webui.sh, docker/Dockerfile.win, docker/Dockerfile.linux and .github/workflows/release.yml. A machine-readable copy of all of it, with no download step beyond this release page, is the aria2-<tag>-webui-<version>-sources.tar.gz asset published next to this archive; it is also browsable at https://github.com/xyj2156/aria2-webui. Should you prefer a copy by other means, open an issue or write to the address in NOTICE and the complete source will be sent for at least three years after this release — that offer is a convenience, not the primary compliance mechanism.

components.name: GNU MP (GMP)
components.role: bignum library used by aria2 for Diffie-Hellman parameters
components.versionScope: pinned for the Windows build; Alpine / Homebrew version on the other platforms
components.copyright: Free Software Foundation, Inc. — the exact copyright years are given in the reproduced licensing statement
components.note: GMP is offered under a dual grant — LGPL-3.0-or-later or GPL-2.0-or-later — as reproduced verbatim in gmp-LICENSE-statement.txt. components.name: musl libc
components.role: C standard library statically linked into the Linux build
components.note: The Linux aria2c is built with LDFLAGS=-static so that it runs on any x86_64 distribution; that links musl statically. musl also carries an explicit statement for jurisdictions that do not recognise public-domain dedication.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.role: TLS backend for the Linux and macOS builds (--with-openssl, static)
components.version: 3.x (Alpine 3.20 / Homebrew openssl@3; resolved at build time)
components.copyright: Copyright 1995-2023 The OpenSSL Project Authors. All Rights Reserved.
components.note: The Windows build does not use OpenSSL at all (aria2 is configured --without-openssl --without-gnutls and uses the WinTLS/SChannel API supplied by the operating system). Linking aria2 with OpenSSL is additionally covered by aria2's own LICENSE.OpenSSL permission, reproduced in LICENSES/aria2-LICENSE.OpenSSL.txt.

components.name: SQLite
components.role: persistent cookie/DNS cache, aria2 built with --with-sqlite3
components.versionScope: pinned for the Windows build; Alpine / Homebrew version on the other platforms
components.copyright: none — the SQLite core software is dedicated to the public domain by its authors
components.note: No license text is required because there is no reservation of rights; see https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html ('SQLite Is Public Domain'). Authors who need a licence grant in a jurisdiction where a public-domain dedication is ineffective are offered an alternative 1-clause BSD-style license by the same authors, also described on that page.

components.name: MinGW-w64 runtime
components.role: CRT and headers of the Windows cross toolchain, statically linked into aria2c.exe
components.version: Ubuntu 22.04 mingw-w64 package (resolved at build time)
components.copyright: see the reproduced files — MinGW-w64 is a work of many authors and each runtime component carries its own permissive license
components.note: COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime.txt enumerates the license of every runtime component; it is shipped verbatim rather than summarised because some components are covered by different (all permissive) terms. One section of it is not permissive: the headers and IDLs imported from the Wine project are LGPL-2.1-or-later, so that text is included too. Those are declarations and headers used at compile time rather than code linked into the executable.

components.name: winpthread
components.role: POSIX threads shim for the Windows build
components.version: Ubuntu 22.04 mingw-w64 package (resolved at build time)

components.name: libstdc++ and libgcc
components.role: C++ standard library and compiler runtime, statically linked on Windows and Linux
components.version: GCC from the build image (Ubuntu 22.04 cross / Alpine 3.20)
components.note: Statically linking libstdc++/libgcc would normally impose GPL obligations on the whole work; the GCC Runtime Library Exception (reproduced in LICENSES/GCC-exception-3.1.txt) is what makes that lawful here. The macOS build links the system libc++ dynamically instead and is not covered by this entry.
